title: NotificationsNoticeSentPayload
description: Payload of `notifications.notice.sent` version 1: Mission Control sent a notice and it was stored for every Location it reached, before any Location was told. The envelope's `partner_id` is `null`. The words are read from `GET /v1/platform/notices/{notice_id}`, never carried here. Consumers must ignore fields they do not know; new optional fields are an additive change.

location_ids.description: The Locations it was stored for.

locations_named.description: How many Locations the request named.

locations_reached.description: How many it was stored for; archived and unknown ones are not counted.

template_id.description: The template its words started from, when one.

sent_by.description: The platform member who sent it.
